# ARUP Lab Test Directory

> Comprehensive laboratory testing directory featuring innovative diagnostic tests, specimen requirements, and clinical reference information for healthcare providers.

ARUP Laboratories operates this test directory to provide detailed information on hundreds of clinical laboratory tests including serology, genetic testing, trace element analysis, and specialized diagnostic assays. The platform includes test scheduling updates, new test announcements, and integration with ARUP Connect for pricing and ordering.

## Key Topics

- ARUP Laboratories
- ARUP Connect

## Test Directory & Reference

- [ARUP Lab Test Directory](https://ltd.aruplab.com): Main test directory homepage showcasing comprehensive medical test menu and innovative lab research capabilities.
- [Thyroglobulin, Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA)](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0020753): Thyroglobulin FNA test for thyroid nodule diagnosis with specimen requirements and methodology.
- [Smith/RNP (ENA) Antibody, IgG](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050470): Smith/RNP antibody test for connective tissue disease diagnosis with specimen collection guidelines.
- [Interleukin 8, Serum](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0051538): Interleukin 8 serum test for immune and inflammatory disorder research using quantitative assay.
- [Hemosiderin, Urine](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0020222): Hemosiderin urine test to detect hemolysis with specimen collection and microscopy methodology.
- [ABO-Rh Prenatal](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0010014): Prenatal ABO-Rh blood typing to assess hemolytic disease risk and Rh immunoglobulin eligibility.
- [Copper, Serum or Plasma](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0020096): Copper serum/plasma test for deficiency/overload assessment using ICP-MS methodology.
- [Sodium, Urine](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0020851): Urine sodium test for quantitative analysis using ion-selective electrode methodology.

## Serology & Infectious Disease Tests

- [Teichoic Acid Antibodies](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050775): Teichoic acid antibody test for staphylococcal disease diagnosis via immunodiffusion.
- [Haemophilus influenzae b Antibody, IgG](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050542): Haemophilus influenzae b antibody test evaluating vaccine response and antibody deficiency.
- [Bartonella henselae Antibody, IgM by IFA](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050092): Bartonella henselae IgM antibody test for early/recent infection via IFA methodology.
- [Treponema pallidum Antibody, IgG by ELISA](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050920): Treponema pallidum IgG ELISA test for syphilis screening using reverse algorithm.
- [Rickettsia typhi (Typhus Fever) Antibody, IgG by IFA](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0050381): Rickettsia typhi IgG antibody test for typhus fever confirmation via IFA methodology.

## Toxicology & Trace Elements

- [Arsenic, Fractionated, Urine](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0020734): Fractionated arsenic urine test for exposure assessment using HPLC methodology.
- [Cadmium, Urine](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0025040): Cadmium urine test assessing chronic exposure and body burden via trace element analysis.

## Genetic & Carrier Screening

- [Tay-Sachs Disease (HEXA), 7 Variants](https://ltd.aruplab.com/Tests/Pub/0051428): Tay-Sachs disease carrier screening for Ashkenazi Jewish and French-Canadian populations.

## Updates & Announcements

- [New Tests](https://ltd.aruplab.com/testing/updates/new): Monthly new test announcements with chronological listings and ARUP Connect pricing information.
- [Performed/Reported Schedule Updates](https://ltd.aruplab.com/updates/performed-reported-updates): Test schedule updates for performed/reported times and turnaround time changes at ARUP Laboratories.
